finalText:
**Redis vanished, and it took the service down with it.**

```
02:14:07  redis refused        → cache off, every read hits the store
02:14:10  store overloads      → 5s timeouts begin, queue at 52
02:15:26  reconnects start     → 13 tries, all refused, one per 80s
02:29:12  queue passes its 500 cap, nothing sheds load
02:31:44  worker-2 out of memory, exits 134
02:31:52  api unresponsive, process group killed, service down
```

- Everything was healthy until 02:14. Last good request was 02:14:03.
- Not one request succeeded after that. 173 timeouts, 174 cache misses.
- The 500 queue cap was never enforced. Depth reached 568.
- Redis refused connections rather than answering slowly. It was gone.
- This log is dated 2026-07-04, not last night.
